normal_path: PinkIKController.forward updates configuration from estimated Isaac state
map_pinocchio_velocity_to_joint_state independently applies pin.integrate(q_current, velocity * dt) to form output targets
failing_path: current Isaac finger2 value is mapped to PINK q[8]
finger_velocity_reason: The full-dimensional PostureTask has an identity Jacobian and regularizes both finger joints toward the posture captured at stage reset.

existing_velocity_evidence.direction: toward the in-limit posture target, not upward

why_pink_velocity_does_not_reach_finger_: After the full 9D PINK target write, project code immediately rewrites DOF indices 7 and 8 with the independent finger_target. Isaac Articulation performs a read-modify-write on selected indices, so the second call wins for the finger targets.
unresolved: The exact PhysX/drive dynamics that changed the measured current position from the final 0.04 target to 0.04000149667263031 were not recorded and cannot be derived from static code alone.
